text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central plaza, a 
crowd caught my eye. Wondering what was 
going on, I took a look—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Honey's definitely better~! It's way 
sweeter than bananas, too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The sugar content of a banana is about 
20%, which surpasses melon. Considering 
the amount consumed in one serving, a 
comparison shows—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You have a look on your face that wonders 
what on earth I am doing, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I agree completely. From the very outset, 
it's enough to give one a headache, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Teio, thank you for training alongside me. 
It's not much, but would you like a 
banana?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When your body is drained of nutrients 
after training, nothing tastes better than 
a banana.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? Well then, don't mind if I 
do!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but honey is still the most delicious 
thing ever! Make sure you don't get that 
twisted, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
…………Teio-kun. On what grounds do you make 
such a claim?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who keeps saying bananas 
are the best, Hayahide, but can you prove 
it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —And that is how the situation unfolded.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Bananas get brown spots right away! 
Don't they go bad super fast!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Those are sugar spots—proof of ripeness 
and the sweetest parts of the banana.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, if you are concerned about 
their shelf life, you can freeze them and 
enjoy them as frozen bananas. They will 
remain thoroughly delicious for about a 
month.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The black, soft spots are the sweetest, 
after all... Frozen bananas are delicious 
like ice cream, too—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*. Still, as expected of 
Hayahide-san. Her logical reasoning and 
sheer volume of knowledge are 
overwhelming. On the other hand, 
Teio-san..."
choice_data_list: Being pushed back a bit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In this case, one can only say 
they were unlucky with their opponent.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
B-But it only lasts for a month! Honey 
lasts for two or three years even at room 
temperature, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't a month be more than enough? In 
the first place, bananas are not meant to 
be stored long-term before eating."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Savor them when they're at their peak of 
ripeness, and once they're gone, just buy 
more bananas. It's as simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Then, uh, um............ what about 
the nutrition!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"In terms of nutritional absorption rate, 
the glucose and fructose found in bananas 
are absorbed extremely quickly—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Objection! Honey is the same way then! Its 
main components are glucose and fructose!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Then wouldn't honey you can just drink 
without chewing be perfect for after a 
tiring workout~?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... However, it is quite viscous. 
Drinking the required amount with a 
parched mouth after exercise is an arduous 
task.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the act of chewing stimulates 
saliva secretion. This should ensure that 
the intake itself is not particularly 
arduous.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
B-But! They're so nutrient-dense you only 
need a little, so I think they're way 
easier to get down than bananas!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san pushed back...?! This might 
actually turn into an unexpected comeback 
victory!
choice_data_list:
In the first place... isn't this about 
which one tastes better?

In the first place... isn't this about 
which one tastes better?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is where it all began.
choice_data_list:
Then why not do a taste test to compare 
them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, when it comes to a match, I kinda 
just get all fired up, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How utterly embarrassing. I got so caught 
up in trying to prove the superiority of 
bananas...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It looks like you've made up, so 
shall we do a taste test together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Drizzle honey over the banana, and— Here 
you go, enjoy♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! The sweetness pairs so 
well, this could totally pass as a 
dessert!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thanks to the honey's synergistic 
effect, it goes down way smoother than 
usual...! This is a breakthrough 
discovery!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Teio-kun. It was solely thanks 
to your knowledge and passion for honey 
that we were able to reach this moment.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Same here! Thanks to you, Hayahide, I 
learned so much about bananas!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio had managed to gain new 
insights from what seemed like an ordinary 
squabble.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, bananas are pretty interesting! They 
have a completely different kind of 
deliciousness before and after they get 
sugar spots~.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The rich sweetness of honey is wonderful 
as well. The satisfaction per serving is 
exceptionally high.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Teio. As for my conclusion this time... 
how about "both are equally superior"?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! They're both delicious! That settles 
it, then♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through their rivalry, each came to 
recognize the other's strengths.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That was delicious! I've been hungry 
forever~

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I haven't eaten a 
thing since after training... Haha.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Bananas might not be bad either. Honey's 
not bad, either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having filled their bellies, the two of 
them found themselves in a peaceful state 
of mind.
